meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: The commercial bank survey every fortnight since 1999: banks' deposits by maturity and their credit to government and the commercial sector, foreign assets and reserves
meta.note: RBI DBIE Data Query tables CSURYCOM_F (components) and CSURYSOR_F (sources), ₹ lakh crore. Series marked 'including the HDFC merger' are RBI's figures from July 2023 that count HDFC Ltd's balance sheet inside the banking system; the plain series exclude it until they stop (time deposits and M3 in June 2025). The two are different rulers and are never joined. 28 zeros printed for discontinued series that exclude the merger (after June 2025) are dropped as not published.
